headline: The garden heals with the zapper
lede: Centipede's forgotten arcade rule is back: die to the swarm and every poisoned or chewed mushroom reverts to normal, 5 points a cap. And the Missile Command sky got meaner — smart bombs that dodge, and a center battery fast enough to punish them.

notes.text: CENTIPEDE — mushroom revival on death: poison clears, chips heal, +5 per regenerated cap (the 1981 rule, verbatim from the sources); caps shot away stay gone. Dice-free, so seeded replays keep bit-exact.

MISSILE COMMAND — waves 7+ field evasive smart bombs: they sense your blasts and sidestep, and only the center battery's faster ABMs can catch one — unless you aim directly on it, the manual's blind spot.

Harness law learned: a DEV probe that textually rhymes with a mutant's source pin silently revives the mutant — the scorpion's poison call reappeared in a test hook and a dead mutant walked. Probes must not rhyme with anchors.
A README gap that no lane may build now says **BLOCKED** (Centipede's fixed per-wave ROM tables) — the idle ladder de-scores it, so the shelf aims at real weakness instead of a dead end, twice.
